See the systems behind the models Learn how teams build systems for data mining, curation, feature engineering, training, and evaluation across massive multimodal datasets. Take home hard-won lessons Hear about the experiments, dataset decisions, failures, and unexpected results behind better models that rarely make it into research papers. Reserve your spot Thursday, November 5, 2026, Contemporary Jewish Museum, San Francisco. $200 • Last call! Apply to Attend Thank you to our sponsors! FAQs What is Reverie? Reverie is a one-day technical summit about the data systems behind world models, generative video, physical AI, multimodal search, and agentic research. The event focuses on how teams curate, enrich, retrieve, prepare, and evaluate the data that models learn from. Who should attend? Reverie is designed for AI researchers, research engineers, ML engineers, and technical leaders working on multimodal data. It is especially relevant to teams building foundation models, world models, video models, robotics and autonomy systems, multimodal search, training infrastructure, and large-scale data pipelines. When and where is Reverie? Reverie takes place on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at the Contemporary Jewish Museum in San Francisco, California. Will sessions be recorded? Select stage talks will be recorded and shared after the event, subject to speaker approval. Breakout discussions and private roundtables will not be recorded. How can my company sponsor Reverie?
